title: Urban view with tall lattice tower framed by adjacent buildings
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.
One tall lattice communication/observation tower is visible near the vertical centre of the image; the tower is fully within the frame.

At least two distinct multi-storey buildings are visible: one beige-clad building with balconies on the left (left edge cropped) and one light-grey or silver-glass facade building on the right (right edge partly cropped).
One external air-conditioning condenser unit is visible on a lower rooftop at the right side of the image (near the right building).
At least five horizontal utility cables or wires cross the lower to mid portion of the image; several are overlapped and partly obscured by trees and buildings, so only a minimum count is certain.
Vegetation: at least one tree or cluster of trees is visible in the lower-central foreground; foliage partly obscures lower structures.
Foreground roof structures and smaller rooftop equipment are visible at the bottom of the image, including a low red-brown roof and other small rooftop fixtures (cropped and partly obscured).
spatial_relations: The tall lattice tower stands approximately in the vertical centre of the image and is framed by two taller building faces on the left and right, creating a narrow vertical gap through which the tower is seen.
The beige building with balconies occupies the left third of the image and is cropped at the left edge; its balconies project slightly into the scene.
The glass-faced light-grey building occupies the right third of the image and is also partially cropped at the right edge; reflective window panels are visible.
Horizontal utility cables run across the image from left to right in the lower and mid sections, appearing in front of the tree canopy and crossing the view of the tower at lower levels.
A cluster of trees and lower rooftop structures sit in the lower central foreground directly beneath the tower, partially obscuring the base of the tower from view.
The air-conditioning condenser unit is located on a lower rooftop at the right side, positioned in front of the right-side building facade from the viewer’s perspective.
